self-attention.caption: 单头自注意力
self-attention.author: Paperstream contributors
self-attention.context: Original simplified single-head scaled dot-product self-attention diagram after Vaswani et al. (2017), Attention Is All You Need. Linear projections are implied by the X-to-Q/K/V arrows; masks, multi-head concatenation and output projection are omitted.
self-attention.changes: Newly drawn, simplified conceptual illustration in editable SVG; no source figures copied. PNG rendered from the SVG without cropping.

residual.caption: 残差连接示意
residual.author: Paperstream contributors
residual.context: Original simplified identity residual block after He et al. (2015 preprint; CVPR 2016), Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. The merge is elementwise addition, not concatenation; normalization and the post-add activation are omitted.
residual.changes: Newly drawn, simplified conceptual illustration in editable SVG; no source figures copied. PNG rendered from the SVG without cropping.

diffusion-structure.caption: 条件扩散去噪
diffusion-structure.author: Paperstream contributors
diffusion-structure.context: Original high-level illustration of AlphaFold 3 (Abramson et al., Nature 2024).
